prompts.name: 01-misty-kingdom
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. The attached image is the reference and edit target for a new composition variant, not a request to reproduce it exactly. Preserve its core visual identity: open aged blank campaign journal, black raven feather, delicate luminous gold threads physically connecting the book to a living fantasy world, dark emerald forest palette and antique gold accents, painterly atmospheric illustration. Wide 16:9 landscape website art. Keep the concept instantly readable with broad shapes and fewer tiny details. No text, lettering, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI, fake screens or digital equipment. Produce ONE standalone image, not a collage. Closest to the original: open journal centered across the lower foreground, raven feather diagonally on its pages, gold threads reaching a distant castle on the left, an ancient tree in the middle, and a lone traveler on the right. Recompose the landscape with softer mist, fewer mountains, simpler silhouettes and a subdued gold dawn.
